title: Compare harvested test-command notes in AGENTS.md versus a prompt append
hypothesis: A verified command appended to the system prompt reduces redundant calls compared with the same line in AGENTS.md, without worse verification or higher cost across repeats.
measurement: Default rotom prompt renderer and cache policy on a scoped tool surface, rotom 0.2.4, openai-codex/gpt-6.2-sol thinking off. Two harvested validation incidents, one documented control, and one historical command drift. Three arms, three repeats, 36 scheduled attempts.
result: 35 scored and one CLI/provider error; a separate initial network setup failure excluded. A/B/C passed 9/11, 9/12, 9/12. Redundant calls 47/29/9; failed commands 14/11/3. C's reduction versus B came entirely from ending the all-fail drift task sooner. On the other tasks B and C both had four redundant calls, and C cost more by the CLI catalog estimate. No production change.
